name: Rufeed Dijeh
original_name: ルフィード・ディジェ
source:
Prince of the Black Kingdom. He is called the "Pure White Black Prince" because of his appearance, which sets him apart from other people. He is ruthless and cruel.

Even though their eyes are captivated by his beauty, there is no one who does not tremble at the sight of him. Aiming for the position of "Black King" who rules the kingdom.

[Translated from [url=http://www.moonparrot.com/html/game/soukoku/chara.html]official website[/url]]
